scripts.dev: npm run build -w @vedanova/contracts && concurrently -n API,WEB -c auto "npm run dev -w @vedanova/api" "npm run dev -w @vedanova/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vedanova/contracts && npm run build -w @vedanova/api && npm run build -w @vedanova/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vedanova/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @vedanova/api && npm run typecheck -w @vedanova/web
